subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should primary-agent browser tabs become task-owned and close at ordinary turn completion by default, or should the current idle/cap cleanup remain the primary-session default?
rationale: Current main intentionally keeps active primary-session tabs reusable and reclaims them by idle/cap policy; changing to completion cleanup is a user-visible default behavior choice with possible surprise-close impact.

options.title: Design task-owned cleanup
options.body: Introduce explicit temporary-tab ownership and close only those tabs after successful turn completion, with preservation rules for user-owned or explicit keep-open tabs.

options.title: Keep idle/cap cleanup only
options.body: Leave the current 120-minute idle and per-session cap behavior as the primary-session default and close the request only after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design task-owned cleanup
recommendation.body: Introduce explicit temporary-tab ownership and close only those tabs after successful turn completion, with preservation rules for user-owned or explicit keep-open tabs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on browser tab reset cleanup and earlier lifecycle cleanup history make this the strongest routing candidate.
